paper: arXiv:2506.21605 -- MemBench: Towards More Comprehensive Evaluation on the Memory of LLM-based Agents
license: README displays an MIT badge; no LICENSE file exists in the repository at the pinned commit. Treated as CLAIMED_NOT_CONFIRMED, not verified MIT.

record_count.note: Full corpus count is an exact, full-scan count (not an estimate). Only a deterministic 275-record sample was carried through normalization in this candidate-preparation pass; see manifests/preprocessing_manifest.json 'sampling_for_normalized_view'.

task_count: 19 category files (10 FirstAgent, 9 ThirdAgent) x 2-5 scenarios each = 55 (variant, category, scenario) task groupings, confirmed by full scan (see reports/raw_inventory.md)
memory_count: Not separately counted as atomic memory units in this pass; each record's message_list contains between 1 and dozens of turns, each a candidate memory unit -- turn-level counting was out of scope for candidate preparation.
known_limitations: PRIMARY: the Google Drive (https://drive.google.com/file/d/112Zraj4pTPH4Idph6i1uMOLA_LPFdGr0/view) and Baidu Pan (https://pan.baidu.com/s/1HqwY0nu5bltSAJ2TbnxcFQ?pwd=yzsj) mirrors documented by the paper/README were NOT independently obtained or re-verified in this session. This was judged unnecessary because the GitHub repository itself was found to bundle the full 26,637-record MemData corpus directly -- but it means the 'data2test' pre-sampled 0-10k/100k length variants the paper's own experiments used (documented as living only in those mirrors) were not inspected, and the two mirrors' exact byte-for-byte content was not cross-checked against what GitHub provides.
No LICENSE file exists in the repository -- MIT is a README badge claim only, not independently confirmed.
requirements.txt is an unresolved Git LFS pointer, not real pinned dependency text -- full reproducibility of the benchmark harness (benchmark/) was not established.

The dialogue-generation pipeline (DialogueGeneration/*.py) imports a 'utils' module (TimeClock, rewrite_message, formulate_QA, etc.) that is not present at the pinned commit -- generation cannot be reproduced from this repo alone.
qid is not a reliable unique identifier (duplicated in ~99% of records per scenario) -- only tid is confirmed unique.
No explicit generation-pipeline metadata (model version, prompt template id, timestamp) is attached to individual records -- provenance is PARTIAL, not full.
Only a 275-record deterministic sample (not the full 26,637-record corpus) was carried through normalization in this pass -- see preprocessing_manifest.json.
preprocessing_actions: See manifests/preprocessing_manifest.json (turn-shape normalization, session-container normalization, evaluator-boundary split, id construction, lineage/equivalence field defaulting, sampling scope decision). All reversible; none lose information.
exclusion_reasons: None -- 0 records excluded (see manifests/exclusion_manifest.json). 0 malformed records found across the full 26,637-record scan.
